episodes.title: Business plan
episodes.summary: Joseph Hazan dreams of launching his own app, not taking over his dad's butcher shop. But a tip from an acquaintance gives him a flash of inspiration.

episodes.title: Deal
episodes.summary: When his plans for the shop hit a snag, Joseph scrambles to get things back on track -- with help from his father's idol, Enrico Macias.

episodes.title: Les porcs d'Amsterdam
episodes.summary: On a wild trip to Amsterdam, Joseph samples the local specialties and begins to see his father in a new light. Meanwhile, Aure packs for Tokyo.

episodes.title: Plantade
episodes.summary: As the Hazans divvy up responsibilities for the new business, Joseph scrambles to make good on both of his promises to Clémentine.

episodes.title: Pastraweed
episodes.summary: Enrico finds a creative solution to Gérard's renovation woes. Out at the country house, a request from the new neighbors sends the family into a panic.

episodes.title: Terminus
episodes.summary: A shocking turn of events leaves the family facing financial ruin and forces them into a showdown with a maniacal criminal.

episodes.title: Le droit chemin
episodes.summary: One year later, business is booming and the family's living large. But when Jo mixes work and parenting, he lands himself in hot water.

episodes.title: Bande rivale
episodes.summary: After striking a deal with Jaurès, Jo has five days to convince his family to quit the weed trade. Aure comes up with a new scheme to launder money.

episodes.title: Le bouillon
episodes.summary: With the botanist on the way and Ludmila out of commission, Aure is forced to impersonate her grandmother. Gérard takes Catherine to meet Enrico Macias.

episodes.title: Dernier petit cadeau
episodes.summary: A visit from Jaurès leaves the family facing a whole new kind of crisis. Élodie gives Aure an ultimatum. Olivier discovers Clémentine's deception.

episodes.title: Exposé plein sud
episodes.summary: As Jo, Gérard and Olivier adjust to their new surroundings, an imposing figure demands a meeting with Jaurès. Aïda tries to uncover a family secret.

episodes.title: Burrata
episodes.summary: Gérard finds a creative way to sneak supplies into the jail, but the night takes an unexpected turn. Aïda's sleuthing results in a big surprise.

episodes.title: Plein nord
episodes.summary: Held captive at a mysterious monastery far from home, the Hazans come face to face with a new crime boss — and immediately make a bad situation worse.

episodes.title: Showtime
episodes.summary: A desperate bid to buy time turns into a mind-blowing adventure for Jo and Olive. Clem talks Youssef into contacting an old prison acquaintance.

episodes.title: Les dix commandements
episodes.summary: After convincing Léonard to try their new product, the family has to figure out how to make more — fast. Catherine finds her loyalties divided.

episodes.title: Boukha pour tout le monde
episodes.summary: Dr. Cliff's truth serum brings family secrets spilling out left and right. A tip from Enrico helps Aïda organize an official rescue mission.

episodes.title: Comme par hasard
episodes.summary: Good news quickly gives way to bad, leaving the family reeling. Clem and Youssef get another chance to play hero. Catherine helps plot an escape.

episodes.title: Mazel tov
episodes.summary: A medical emergency puts Clem and Youssef in an awkward spot. Meanwhile, Aure tries doing things her way — and sets off a wild race toward freedom.
